sentences.en: At last firemen have put out a big forest fire in California.
sentences.zh: 消防员终于扑灭了加利福尼亚的一场森林大火。

sentences.en: Yesterday the firemen examined the ground carefully, but they were not able to find any broken glass.
sentences.zh: 昨天消防员仔细检查了地面，但没有找到任何碎玻璃。

article.en: At last firemen have put out a big forest fire in California.
article.zh: 消防员终于扑灭了加利福尼亚的一场森林大火。

article.en: Since then, they have been trying to find out how the fire began.
article.zh: 从那以后，他们一直在设法查明火灾的起因。

article.en: Forest fires are often caused by broken glass or by cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away.
article.zh: 森林火灾常常是由碎玻璃或人们随手扔掉的烟头引起的。

article.en: Yesterday the firemen examined the ground carefully, but they were not able to find any broken glass.
article.zh: 昨天消防员仔细检查了地面，但没有找到任何碎玻璃。

article.en: They were also quite sure that a cigarette end did not start the fire.
article.zh: 他们也非常肯定烟头没有引起这场火灾。

article.en: This morning, however, a fireman accidentally discovered the cause.
article.zh: 然而今天早上，一名消防员偶然发现了起火的原因。

article.en: He noticed the remains of a snake which was wound round the electric wires of a power line.
article.zh: 他发现了缠在高压电线上的蛇的残骸。

article.en: A bird had snatched up the snake from the ground and then dropped it on to the wires.
article.zh: 一只鸟从地上抓起这条蛇，然后把它扔到了电线上。

article.en: The snake wound itself round the wires and sent sparks down to the ground.
article.zh: 蛇缠在电线上，向地面迸出火花。

article.en: These sparks immediately started a fire.
article.zh: 这些火花立刻引起了火灾。
